name: Describe Program Member
summary: Shows the program member object: its key fields (leadId, programId, statusName…) and which fields can be filtered or updated.
whenToUse: Before working with program members — to see the available fields and the valid filter fields for Get Program Members.

response.description: Object metadata: dedupeFields, searchableFields, and a fields list with updateable flags.

notes: The 'updateable' flag on each field tells you what you can write with Sync Program Member Data.
